items.name: map-pins
items.prompt: overhead view of a printed topographic map of a game reserve with green bush, blue rivers, a dam, contour lines and pale dirt roads, flat on a corkboard. Three separate winding routes, each marked by four or five map pins joined by its own coloured thread: a red route along the river in the north, a blue route along a road in the south, a yellow route curving down the east side. The three threads stay apart and never cross each other; no X shape, no straight diagonal lines
items.style: a clean printed cartographic map in muted natural colours, crisp map linework, the corkboard edge visible, no text, no letters, no labels, no logos
